FN-NPKATJJ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 70
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative A.J. McCampbell
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/19/2024
House Bill 70 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Board of Dental Examiners,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2024, by (1) up to $150 for each Special Volunteer Licenses, created
by this bill, issued to dentists and dental hygienists; and (2) a maximum of $368,000 annually
dependent on the difference in the current Dental Hygiene Annual Registration fee (currently
capped at $75 by statute and set at $70 by the board) and any increase of the fee by the board, up
to the new $150 statutory cap set by this bill.
Page 1
